thread_text:
Maya Patel: Heads-up 1: recruiting ops says several interviewers couldn't access scorecards this morning during panel creation. Panels affected: 8347, 8348, 8350. Any recent ATS or schema changes?
Jon Rivera: I pushed a small PR yesterday that tightened the JSON schema for scorecards (removed 'notes_freeform' optional property). I didn't think ATS would still send it but looks like older integrations do.
Priya Desai: We got panicked DMs from recruiting saying they saw a 422 on panel creation. I saved one payload: {panel_id:8347, scorecard:{sections:[...], notes_freeform:"left feedback"}}
Samir Khan: That matches an importer exception I saw in the logs: 
ERROR importer: unknown_field 'notes_freeform' at path scorecard
Stack: Importer.v2.deserialize -> ValidationError
Maya Patel: Can we make the importer tolerant of unknown fields quickly? We need to unblock same-day interviews.
Samir Khan: Yes. Plan: 1) revert the strict validation in the importer to ignore unknown fields (hotfix), 2) run a small backfill for the listed panels, 3) add a migration to normalize old scorecards and strip 'notes_freeform' later. I'm starting the hotfix now.
Jon Rivera: Sorry team, my bad for landing that without the compatibility shim. I'll follow up with a test to catch ATS legacy fields.
Priya Desai: I'll tell recruiting ops to hold new panel creation for 30m and notify impacted hiring teams.
RecruitBot: alert created: ticket R-2026-521 "Scorecard import failures from legacy ATS fields" assigned to Samir Khan due 2026-06-15
Samir Khan: Hotfix deployed to canary. Monitoring metrics and error stream. Backfill command (ops): `./tools/ats-import --panel 8347 --reconcile`
Maya Patel: Thanks. After backfill finishes please paste the success count here so HR can confirm candidates have live scorecards. Also add a short note to the interviewer guide clarifying the deprecated 'notes_freeform' field.
Samir Khan: Will do. Backfill started, posting results when done. :thumbsup:
